name: effort-auto
description: Adaptive thinking effort for the main conversation only: rest at low, raise it by steps when judgement is needed.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the plugin on. When off it changes no request, injects no rules and registers no tool.

maxRaises.title: Raises per turn
maxRaises.description: How many effort raises one turn accepts; the ones past it are ignored with a message to the model.

maxHighSteps.title: Steps per raise to high
maxHighSteps.description: The longest one raise to high or xhigh may last.

logPath.title: Log path
logPath.description: The JSONL file that records every step. Empty: ~/.claude/effort-auto/steps-<session>.jsonl.
